answer: Make each epoch's work allocation a lottery where every identity must burn a non-refundable entry fee and can win at most one task. A wharf issues only one berthing ticket per vessel, so extra hulls create no extra berths; likewise, a Sybil operator pays the fee for every fake identity while the reward pool stays fixed, so duplication multiplies cost without multiplying expected payout. Like a meadow feeding fewer sheep per head as the flock grows, and a karst passage admitting only one traveller at a time, the cap makes scale itself unprofitable.
